admission.justification: Valid IDs alone do not produce truthful waves, correct waves alone do not synchronize page/head/Markdown views, and drawing alone does not preserve gone/cyclic/absent-data meaning; only these members together make one dependency order survive writing and every named reader.

guarantee: Explicit same-master prerequisite data, current master-row states and their derived waves jointly produce a consistent ordinary-master Order in the dashboard and Markdown and both directions in task heads. Invalid new references are refused; gone historical references remain visible until an explicit field write; legacy cycles stay identified in one marked wave, including members in work; no declared dependency data produces no Order. This informs rather than gates task starts and does not replace the sprint’s authored execution graph.
title: One derived master order across authoring and readers
